material.acceptance_criteria: A test or witness reuses a unit slot with a different unit type and reads the rule values from the new unit, matching the 6.88g source for that type. Witness: a gate or workspace test that fails before the fix and passes after, read on the pushed sha.
material.description: scenarios/moba/unit_rules.lua caches the values it applied per unit slot. When a slot is reused for a new unit, the cache can keep the previous unit's defaults, so the new unit runs with the wrong rules. Reported by hy3d; not fixed in its commits.
